question: What’s the distance to the closest viewpoint starting from Lockheed A-12 Blackbird, San Diego, CA?
sql:
SELECT *, ST_Distance(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.153969 32.726821)',4326)::geography)  AS distance  FROM pois
WHERE tourism = 'viewpoint'
ORDER BY geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.153969 32.726821)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.description: View over the Japanese Friendship Garden
